title: IFRS9/SICR estimand readiness
target_claim: Document why available terminal and snapshot fields cannot identify report-date PD ECL SICR or staging.
hard_blockers: No loan-report-date unit; No monthly account performance panel; No contractual days-past-due history before default; No staging labels; No borrower-level macro scenario path

title: Fair lending and protected-attribute governance
target_claim: Keep legal fair-lending claim false; improve proxy/source governance.
hard_blockers: No race, ethnicity, sex or age; No surname for BISG; No full address or Census tract

title: CATE and causal policy value
target_claim: Reopen only as observational price/tightness sensitivity, not policy value.
hard_blockers: Only accepted/funded loans are visible; No randomized pricing or approval instrument; No rejected-applicant counterfactuals in the retained project data

title: Post-selection online and source diagnostics
target_claim: Describe source-family coverage fragility; keep holdout and deployable claims false.
hard_blockers: No independent external source distribution; No production feedback loop; Only retrospective post-selection issue-month evaluation

title: Differentiable SPO/DFL
target_claim: Retain a teacher-cost prototype in an isolated environment; do not transfer it into active CRPTO.
hard_blockers: Differentiable optimization dependency and scaling risk; No realized costs matched model classes or independent menus

title: Exact DLA/ADP and Bellman optimality
target_claim: Keep exact optimality false; improve rollout simulator features.
hard_blockers: No monthly borrower state trajectory; No actual sequential decision logs; No realized action policy history beyond accepted loans

title: CVaR/OCE conditional tail diagnostic
target_claim: Describe the tail-risk tradeoff under the internal simulator; do not select a policy.
hard_blockers: The paired replay is conditional and retrospective; no independent evaluation or external dominance
